schemas.name: result_read
schemas.description: Read, project or aggregate retained data without rerunning its action. For arithmetic use aggregate (sum/count/avg/min/max) and field; the tool computes over ALL retained rows. retainedComplete describes that calculation; sourceCoverage.provenComplete separately states whether source completeness is proven. fields selects only needed columns without bulky payloads. path defaults to /rows for these operations. id is modelContext.resultId or the last segment of view. all=true returns the whole selected value as typed JSON in one call; otherwise JSON text pages have nextCursor. Optional JSON pointer selects /rows/0 or /flowMap. References expire with retention; save important evidence to task memory. Private to the original user/story.

path.description: RFC 6901 JSON pointer; empty reads the root, or /rows for projection/aggregation

fields.description: Project these exact top-level row fields; combine with all=true for all projected rows. Cannot combine with aggregate.

aggregate.description: Compute over the full retained array, never its preview. Numeric operations require field; count counts rows.

field.description: Exact numeric row field for sum/avg/min/max; omit for count

max_bytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 JSON text bytes per page
